name: Ungaikyou - Sui
source:
Ungaikyou (literally: "the mirror beyond the clouds") is a youkai made from the failure attempt of Amaterasu’s mirror called Mafutsu no Kagami (an alternate spelling of [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yata_no_Kagami]Yata no Kagami[/url]). Her duty is to protect and maintain order in the Infinite Corridor. She has a complex with being made from a "failure" and dislikes the Ayakashibito world. In an effort to [spoiler]make the Infinite Corridor her own world, she pulled two wandering spirits from going to the netherworld…[/spoiler]
Her name originally was only Ungaikyou, however after the creation of her little sister she added Sui after her name.

[Edited from a really spoiler-filled [url=http://whatistomato.wordpress.com/2010/12/12/chronobelt-review]Chrono Belt review[/url] by Warum]
